title: EcoGuard selected CBAM requirement-to-code coverage map

scope.code_surface: src/ecoguard/cbam.py at the v0.5.0 calculation boundary
scope.purpose: Separate implemented technical arithmetic from selected statutory rules that remain partial or absent.
excluded_claims: This is not an exhaustive inventory of Regulation (EU) 2023/956 or its delegated and implementing acts.
A partial arithmetic match does not establish legal eligibility, filing correctness, or an amount payable.
The matrix does not replace review by qualified CBAM, customs, emissions-verification, tax, or legal professionals.

sources.version_note: Official Journal act of 2025-10-08, published 2025-10-17; used to bind the 2025-10-20 consolidation and the amended de minimis and declaration rules.

sources.version_note: Adopted 2025-12-10, published 2025-12-22, and entered into force on the third day following publication.

summary.interpretation: No selected statutory pathway is represented as fully implemented. Partial means a traceable technical subset or arithmetic analogy only.

requirements.title: Goods, origin, territory, and exemption scope
requirements.regulatory_requirement: Determine whether the imported goods, their origin and destination, and any territorial or activity exemption place the import within CBAM scope.

citations.provision: Articles 2 and 2a; Annexes I, III, and VII

missing_behavior: No Annex I goods lookup or greenhouse-gas mapping
No origin or exempt-country decision
No electricity, hydrogen, military-use, inward-processing, or territorial exception handling

missing: Authoritative Annex I and Annex III versioned tables

formula.official_rule: A legal classification decision across the regulation's goods, origin, territory, and exemption conditions.
formula.ecoguard_behavior: Only checks that a supplied CN code contains eight digits.

requirements.title: Single mass-based de minimis threshold
requirements.regulatory_requirement: Aggregate relevant annual imports per importer and decide whether the single mass-based threshold applies, including the consequence of exceeding it during the year.

missing_behavior: No importer-level calendar-year aggregation
No versioned Annex VII threshold
No electricity or hydrogen exception
No retroactive all-import treatment after the threshold is exceeded

missing: Goods category needed for threshold exceptions

formula.official_rule: Compare importer-level cumulative annual net mass across covered CN codes with the applicable Annex VII threshold.
formula.ecoguard_behavior: Validates only that one shipment mass is positive and reconciles with two fixture items.

requirements.title: Annual declaration quantity and embedded-emissions fields
requirements.regulatory_requirement: The annual declaration includes total quantity by type of goods, total embedded emissions, and the certificate quantity after applicable reductions and adjustments.

implemented_behavior: Reconciles two synthetic item masses to a shipment total
Produces a traceable technical embedded-emissions total
missing_behavior: No authorised declarant, registry submission, calendar-year grouping, or filing deadline
No legally adjusted certificate quantity
No declaration format or installation-country aggregation

formula.official_rule: Report annual totals by goods type and the certificate quantity after Article 9 and Article 31 adjustments.
formula.ecoguard_behavior: Sums fixture item masses and technical component emissions for one case.

requirements.title: CN-code mapping to covered goods and production boundaries
requirements.regulatory_requirement: Map the CN code to Annex I coverage, greenhouse gases, aggregated goods category, functional unit, and production-process system boundaries.

implemented_behavior: Rejects a CN-code value that is not exactly eight digits
missing_behavior: No authoritative CN lookup
No aggregated-goods-category or greenhouse-gas mapping
No sector-specific functional units or system boundaries

formula.official_rule: Select system boundaries and functional units from the official category mapping before emissions are attributed.
formula.ecoguard_behavior: Uses one supplied code as a descriptor without a legal classification lookup.

requirements.title: Actual specific embedded emissions
requirements.regulatory_requirement: Calculate actual embedded emissions using the applicable system boundaries, attributed direct and eligible indirect emissions, activity level, and official monitoring rules.

citations.provision: Chapter 2, especially Articles 2-10 and Annexes I-II

implemented_behavior: Multiplies imported item mass by supplied component intensity
Reconciles component intensity with supplied item intensity and shipment weighted intensity
Preserves exact decimal arithmetic and operand provenance
missing_behavior: Does not derive attributed emissions from installation monitoring data
Does not determine activity level or official reporting period
Does not apply sector system boundaries, measurement uncertainty, biomass, waste gas, carbon capture, or allocation rules

present: Precomputed direct and indirect component intensities
missing: Installation monitoring plan and source streams
Activity data and official calculation factors
Production output by functional unit and reporting period

formula.official_rule: For simple goods, specific emissions are attributed emissions divided by activity level; complex-goods rules add eligible precursor emissions before division.
formula.ecoguard_behavior: Imported technical inventory equals the sum of item mass multiplied by supplied component intensities.

requirements.title: Complex goods and precursor attribution
requirements.regulatory_requirement: For complex goods, include eligible precursor emissions using the required production process, reporting-period, installation, and weighted-average rules.

citations.provision: Articles 13-15; Annex II equations for complex goods

implemented_behavior: Separately traces synthetic precursor-direct and precursor-indirect intensity components
Reconciles precursor plus process axes to the technical total
missing_behavior: No precursor eligibility by Annex I, origin, or exemption
No precursor mass-consumption or reporting-period calculation
No weighted average across supplying installations
No actual-versus-default selection per precursor

formula.official_rule: Complex-goods specific emissions add eligible precursor mass multiplied by precursor specific emissions to attributed emissions, then divide by activity level.
formula.ecoguard_behavior: Adds pre-supplied precursor intensity components to process components and multiplies the resulting intensity by imported item mass.

requirements.title: Indirect-emissions eligibility and electricity methodology
requirements.regulatory_requirement: Include indirect emissions only where the regulation and category rules require them, using official default electricity values unless the criteria for actual electricity emissions are met.

citations.provision: Article 7(1), 7(4); Annex II; Annex IV points 4.3 and 6
Articles 3, 8, and 11; sector boundaries in Annex I

implemented_behavior: Separately totals supplied process-indirect and precursor-indirect intensity components
Retains electricity quantity as unused evidence rather than inventing an emission factor
missing_behavior: No Annex II eligibility decision
No official electricity emission-factor lookup
No actual-electricity criteria, direct technical link, or power-purchase-agreement evidence
No conversion of retained electricity quantity into emissions

formula.official_rule: Apply category-specific indirect-emissions eligibility and the official default or qualifying actual electricity method.
formula.ecoguard_behavior: Always includes supplied indirect components in the technical inventory and makes no legal eligibility decision.

requirements.title: Official default values
requirements.regulatory_requirement: Use the applicable Commission default value or a permitted alternative, with the required geography, goods type, mark-up, and indirect-emissions treatment.

implemented_behavior: Multiplies shipment mass by a provenance-bearing fixture default intensity
Reports an explicit comparison with the synthetic actual-data inventory
missing_behavior: No Commission default-value dataset or version
No goods-country-region selection or mark-up
No permitted alternative-default decision
No statutory treatment of defaults in certificate reductions or free allocation

formula.official_rule: Select the legally applicable value from Implementing Regulation 2025/2621 and apply the methods and conditions in Annex IV and Implementing Regulation 2025/2547.
formula.ecoguard_behavior: Calculates shipment mass multiplied by a supplied educational default intensity.

requirements.title: Regulatory records for embedded-emissions calculations
requirements.regulatory_requirement: Keep sufficiently detailed calculation records and verification material for the period and content required by Article 7 and Annex V.

implemented_behavior: Records local evidence identifiers, document locations, hashes, units, formulas, and derived-step links
Keeps a deterministic technical calculation trace
missing_behavior: No Annex V completeness assessment
No operator emissions report or official template
No four-year retention control or registry storage
No regulatory access, amendment, or audit workflow

missing: Official monitoring plan and operator report

formula.official_rule: Maintain the prescribed calculation and verification records in sufficient detail for review and for the statutory retention period.
formula.ecoguard_behavior: Creates local provenance and arithmetic traces without claiming Annex V bookkeeping compliance.

requirements.title: Accredited verification of actual emissions
requirements.regulatory_requirement: Actual embedded emissions in the declaration are verified by an accredited verifier under Annex VI and the applicable verification rules.

missing_behavior: No verifier accreditation check
No verification engagement, risk analysis, site visit, or opinion
No five-percent materiality-level evaluation or expert-judgement pathway
No Commission verification-report template

formula.official_rule: A qualified verifier performs the prescribed assurance process and issues the required verification report.
formula.ecoguard_behavior: Local hash and provenance validation is not emissions verification and does not satisfy Article 8.

requirements.title: Reduction for a carbon price paid in a third country
requirements.regulatory_requirement: Reduce certificates only under the applicable actual-payment or yearly-default pathway, accounting for rebates, evidence, independent certification, currency conversion, and the conversion to certificate quantity.

implemented_behavior: Subtracts a supplied third-country price from a supplied certificate price with a zero floor for educational price sensitivity
Preserves the supplied price evidence reference
missing_behavior: No eligibility decision between actual-payment and yearly-default pathways
No rebate, compensation, refund, or effective-payment calculation
No independent certification or payment evidence
No yearly exchange rate or conversion into certificate quantity
Applies the same illustrative subtraction to the default-value scenario without claiming statutory validity

present: Synthetic EUR per tCO2e third-country price
missing: Yearly exchange rate and applicable conversion methodology

formula.official_rule: Convert an eligible effectively paid or yearly default carbon price into a reduction in certificates under Article 9 and its applicable implementing rules.
formula.ecoguard_behavior: Sensitivity exposure equals technical emissions times a scenario factor times the non-negative difference between two supplied unit prices.

requirements.title: Official CBAM certificate price
requirements.regulatory_requirement: Use the Commission-calculated and published CBAM certificate price, including the 2026 quarterly and later weekly methodology applicable to the import period.

missing_behavior: No EU ETS auction feed or Commission-published price lookup
No import-quarter or calendar-week selection
No volume-weighted auction average or official cent rounding
No versioned price publication record

formula.official_rule: For 2026, calculate a quarterly volume-weighted average of qualifying EU ETS auction clearing prices; apply the later weekly rule where required.
formula.ecoguard_behavior: Accepts one evidence-bearing educational unit price and never labels it an official certificate price.

requirements.title: Free allocation adjustment
requirements.regulatory_requirement: Adjust the number of certificates to reflect EU ETS free allocation under Article 31 and the actual-value or default-value method in Implementing Regulation 2025/2620.

missing_behavior: No specific embedded free allocation
No actual-value or default-value adjustment method
No precursor free-allocation averaging
No electricity zero-adjustment rule

missing: Applicable EU ETS benchmark and free-allocation data

formula.official_rule: Apply the Article 31 free-allocation adjustment using Implementing Regulation 2025/2620 and its Annex.
formula.ecoguard_behavior: The analyst-defined scenario exposure factor is not a free-allocation factor and no official adjustment is calculated.

requirements.title: Statutory number of certificates to surrender
requirements.regulatory_requirement: Determine the certificate quantity from declared and verified embedded emissions after the eligible third-country carbon-price reduction and free-allocation adjustment.

missing_behavior: No verified statutory embedded-emissions basis
No eligible Article 9 certificate reduction
No Article 31 free-allocation adjustment
No certificate-count output

present: Synthetic technical emissions and price assumptions

formula.official_rule: Compute the certificate count after the legally applicable emissions, Article 9, and Article 31 steps.
formula.ecoguard_behavior: Returns gross educational euro exposure and explicitly sets statutory_calculator and statutory_obligation to false.

requirements.title: Registry surrender and quarterly account balance
requirements.regulatory_requirement: Surrender certificates through the CBAM registry by the applicable deadline and maintain the required quarterly account balance from the applicable year.

missing_behavior: No CBAM registry integration
No certificate purchase, holding, surrender, or removal workflow
No annual deadline or quarterly balance control
No account reconciliation

formula.official_rule: Maintain the required registry balance and surrender the legally determined number of certificates by the prescribed dates.
formula.ecoguard_behavior: Produces offline JSON for an educational scenario and performs no external registry action.

technical_controls_outside_statutory_cov.description: Every technical inventory leaf keeps selected source, location, and hash evidence, and every derived value names its prior step.
The calculation boundary rejects missing, non-finite, negative, unit-inconsistent, and provenance-invalid fixture inputs.
Mass, component intensity, weighted intensity, and two independent component axes must reconcile before a scenario is returned.
